description: The master list of free label lines: every line name that labels print and the registry has no key for (a botanical, a branded blend, "creatine monohydrate"), as stored under line:<name>, with how many items state it (entities), from how many proofs (sources), and in which units. Search by part of the name. Each name is an unverified nutrient: lines with exactly the same name add up in nutrition, compute_recipe and check_intake, and filter and sort in query like any nutrient. Different spellings are different lines; nothing links them yet.

q.description: Part of the name, e.g. "creatine". Matched on the normalised name (lower case, spaces collapsed, ® and ™ removed).

name: label_lines
